verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at developer.vanta.com that indexes APIs, the MCP server and integration guides. Docs pages are served as .md variants that point agents to the llms.txt index. Vanta also publishes agentskills.io-spec skill files and a Developer Docs MCP server for AI coding tools. Missing for 10: no publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec at standard paths (probe 404s), and no independent community corroboration of agents using these docs in practice.
